source.product: Historical Annual Spring Indices, First Leaf, PRISM

predictability_definition.primary: For focal bird-year y, Pearson correlation between annual First Leaf dates at the paired south and north receiver cells using 1981 through y-1.
predictability_definition.equivalence_note: Using annual date rather than anomaly gives exactly the same Pearson correlation because the anomaly transformation subtracts a site-specific constant.

mandatory_sensitivity.common_window: 1981-2015 for every bird, because 2016 is the earliest focal tracking year
mandatory_sensitivity.rank_measure: Spearman correlation on the same annual values

first_allowed_outputs: number of individual bird routes whose two receiver coordinates fall inside the PRISM spatial extent
number of unique paired routes whose two receiver coordinates fall inside the PRISM spatial extent

wcs_request_rule.request_reference: USGS Open-File Report 2017-1003 WCS request construction

stop_rule: If source coverage or WCS access fails, close the PRISM-primary V7 route rather than replacing the environmental predictor after outcome access.
